title: The point guard job
blueprint: Value / belief post: 'PG is glorified' → it's the hardest job. Bank: December (evergreen)
goal: Shift the belief that point guard is the glamour spot; show the six things the job asks, with real reps from the Monday session

hooks: Everyone wants to be the point guard. Not many want the work.
Think you're a point guard because you dribble the most? Watch this.
Point guard is the most glorified spot on the floor. It's also the hardest.
close_loop: Dribbling's the easy part. Handling pressure and making the play: that's the job.

shots.vo: Not many want the work that comes with it.
Here's what the job really asks. Most players skip number six.
One: protect the ball when they're all over you.
Three: get past your defender in the half court.
Four: get downhill in the full court.
Six: take all that pressure, start the offence, and make the right play.
Dribbling's the easy part. Handling pressure and making the play: that's the job.
